segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let myPOICategory = "NearbyPlaceOfInterestCategoryIdentifier" let myPOIThread = "NearbyPlaceOfInterestThreadIdentifier" // Create the local notification's content. let content = UNMutableNotificationContent() content.title = "Grand Canyon" content.body = "You are within 50 miles of the Grand Canyon" // Enable grouping by adding a thread identifier. content.threadIdentifier = myPOIThread // Then create the request for the notification. let request = UNNotificationRequest(identifier: myPOICategory, content: content) ```
